title: Natural locally constant description of the constant abelian sheaf
statement: Let X be a topological space and A an abelian group, and suppose the category of abelian groups in the universe of A admits sheafification on the open site of X [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Let A_X be the constant abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. There exist additive equivalences e_U:A_X(U) ≃ LocallyConstant(U,A) for all opens U, including the empty open, such that for every inclusion V ⊆ U, every s ∈ A_X(U), and every x ∈ V, e_V(s|_V)(x) = e_U(s)(x). No irreducibility or connectedness assumption is made.

source.place: Definition 006W and Example 0081; source text read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/006W and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0081

proof.text: Extract the underlying sheaf of sets from the abelian sheaf using the corepresentability of the forgetful functor by ULift Z. Prove elementwise local separation and arbitrary-index open-cover gluing for this underlying sheaf directly from the sheaf condition [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. These are the proved private helpers abelian_underlying_isSheaf, abelian_section_ext and abelian_gluing.

Inside the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], take on each open the subgroup of sections which locally lie in the image of its unit. Restriction preserves this property; addition uses intersections of representative neighbourhoods and negation uses the negative representative. Compatible sections glue in the ambient sheaf, and the glued section is locally represented because each point is in a cover member. Thus the subpresheaf is a sheaf. Factor the constant-presheaf unit through it and lift by [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. The lift composed with the inclusion is the identity by sheafification uniqueness. Every ambient section therefore has a local constant representative. All of this is proved in constantSheaf_unit_localSurj.

For a point x and coefficient group A, the skyscraper presheaf taking A on opens containing x and the terminal group otherwise satisfies the sheaf condition: if x lies in the covered open, choose a member containing it and use compatibility to transport its value to every other member containing x; otherwise all values are unique. The natural map from the constant presheaf to this sheaf factors through sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. On every open containing x its component is an isomorphism, so the constant-presheaf unit is injective there. The private helpers skyscraper_abelian_isSheaf and unit_inj prove these assertions without universe identifications.

For a section s over U and point x in U, choose a local representative a. Two choices agree on a neighbourhood intersection by the unit injectivity of the preceding step. This gives a locally constant function, constant on every representative neighbourhood. Naturality of the unit and common intersections show that the evaluation maps commute with restriction and addition, and send zero to zero. Equality of evaluations implies local equality of representatives, hence equality of sections by separation.

For a locally constant function f, its fibres are opens in U. The constant sections with value a on the fibre of a are compatible: on overlaps containing a point the values agree, and on empty overlaps separation gives equality. Glue the sections using abelian_gluing. The representative-value calculation proves that the glued section evaluates to f. Thus the additive evaluation maps are bijective; apply AddEquiv.ofBijective and the already proved pointwise restriction identity. Empty opens require no exception.

proof_origin.place: Tags 006W, 007B and 0081; direct unit-local-representative argument formalized by P3, using sheafification uniqueness for local surjectivity and a skyscraper factorization for injectivity.
